_comment: THE COMPLETE LIST OF URLs THIS SYSTEM MAY FETCH. Nothing else is reachable.
The language model NEVER sees this file and NEVER supplies a URL. It cannot
ask for a page that is not here, because it is not asked which page to get:
selection is done by deterministic keyword matching in allowlist.py against
the 'topics' below. An LLM that generated URLs would be an open proxy with
TO ADD A PAGE: add an entry here and restart the backend. Editing this file
is a deliberate, reviewable act — which is the point.
id          stable identifier, used in logs
url         the EXACT absolute URL fetched. No wildcards, no patterns.
label       shown to users as the source of the information
topics      lowercase keywords; a question matching these selects this page
enabled     false parks an entry without deleting it
The three entries below are SAMPLES so the feature is testable out of the
box. Replace them with the college's real pages before rollout.
